note: Heli-Harness v1 narration. start = absolute frame (60fps) in HeliV1; slot = last frame the speech may reach. Square brackets are Eleven v4 audio tags.

lines.text: [dry] Your agents can push, publish, and wipe a folder. Each one with its own rules.
[confident] Heli-Harness gives them one rulebook. Install it once, link your project, and it hooks into the agents you already use.
So an agent tries to push? Stopped, right at the hook. And it tells the agent exactly why, and who gets to say yes.
[matter-of-fact] That’s you. In your own terminal. The agent can’t grant itself anything. It tried. Allow once, and once means once.
[firm] Some lines don’t move at all. Hard resets. Recursive deletes. No grant, no YOLO gets past those.
Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, Kimi. One set of rules.
[warm, confident] Heli-Harness. Let your agents move fast, and keep the keys.
